summary: End-to-end test of the 8 new features (Demo Sample Case, Sample Walkthrough tour, Session Prep PDF, Post-Session Outcome, Follow-up cron, Upcoming Check-Ins panel, Closing Summary w/ outcome, /api/health build). Backend: ran the 5 feature pytest modules (15/15 PASS) plus a new /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_38_review.py covering health build='2026-09-10.14', session-outcome 400/401/403 error codes, cron auth (401 without secret, 200 with Bearer + {run_id}), and a full NEW-case → outcome → close → closing-summary.pdf flow verifying 'Session outcome' and chosen step text in the PDF (7/7 PASS). Existing sample case of approval.test.pro1 was preserved (not deleted or closed) per instructions. Frontend: logged in as approval.test.pro1, verified load-sample-case-btn is HIDDEN (sample already exists), SAMPLE badge (case-row-sample-<id>) present in cases-table, upcoming-checkins panel renders on dashboard above the cases table with count=1 and chip 'Tomorrow' after saving outcome, and no horizontal overflow at 390px (panel scrollWidth 356 ≤ 390). On the report page: sample-tour-banner + start button work, sample-tour-card advances Section 1→10 (progress data-testid confirmed), matching report section receives class 'tour-highlight', Back moves 10→9, last-step button label switches to 'Finish' and finishing closes the card, banner text becomes 'Sample case. Take the 10-step tour again any time.'. Session Prep: session-prep-btn is an <A> with href /api/joint/reports/<id>/session-prep.pdf; GET with pro cookies returns 200 application/pdf with Content-Disposition 'attachment; filename="session-prep-SA-…pdf"'. Backend test confirms parent/non-creator gets 403. Session Outcome: session-outcome-step-0 & step-2 toggle to aria-pressed=true, summary + follow-up date (tomorrow) save, session-outcome-recorded shows 'Last saved …', session-outcome-count shows '2 steps chosen'; after reload, selections/summary/date persist; pro-lifecycle-list contains an entry with 'Session outcome recorded', '2 next steps chosen' and the follow-up date. Overall 22/22 executed backend tests pass and all frontend acceptance criteria met. One minor spec vs. implementation discrepancy noted (see below): there is no separate 'sample-tour-finish-btn' testid — the same 'sample-tour-next-btn' element flips its label to 'Finish' on the last step and triggers close/finish.
action_items: Optional / non-blocking: the review spec mentions a `data-testid=sample-tour-finish-btn` on the last step, but the current implementation reuses `sample-tour-next-btn` (label changes to 'Finish'). Behavior is correct and the review spec's UX requirement is satisfied. If you want future automation to target Finish separately, add data-testid=sample-tour-finish-btn to that same button on the last step (e.g. `data-testid={last ? 'sample-tour-finish-btn' : 'sample-tour-next-btn'}`).
critical_code_review_comments: SampleWalkthrough.jsx uses one merged button (sample-tour-next-btn) for both Next and Finish. Works, but keeping the same testid across two different actions makes E2E tests brittle. Consider dual testids as noted above.
